answer: To post a job: register a company account, then complete your company profile (entity details, tax/registration identifiers) and wait for OpenOpportunity admin verification — this can take a little time. Once verified, you can post job listings from your company dashboard; each posting goes through admin approval before it's publicly visible and searchable.
